# HEM v0.8.6b4 – Individual trend lines and adaptive PID calibration

Tap a measurement, HEM target, PID demand, device output or sensor limit to hide its line and markers. Its label and value turn grey. Tap again to restore its color and see its value at the cursor.

Each series can be toggled independently, including the low and high limits of a target range. Your selection follows you across time ranges while the trend window is open.

Adaptive PID now collects readings when HEM chooses heating or cooling automatically. In device settings, **Valid observations** shows the reading count and elapsed observation time. A thermostat cycling between heating and idle can contribute to the same observation. A change of direction, lost device feedback or a manual control change starts a new observation.
